verdict.rationale: Google documents an official Gemini API CLI (`gemini-api`). It is a stateless, zero-dependency command-line client built for AI agents with shell access, scripts, and CI pipelines, and it can generate text and media, analyze files, and delegate to managed agents. Separately, the google-gemini GitHub org publishes terms and telemetry docs for the official Gemini CLI, which corroborates first-party CLI tooling. Missing for 10: detailed command/install reference in evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of the gemini-api CLI's behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Gemini API CLI (`gemini-api`) is a stateless, zero-dependency command-line client built for AI agents with shell access, scripts, and CI pipelines.
Your coding agent can use it to generate text and media, analyze files, and delegate tasks to [Gemini managed agents].
You may opt-out from sending Gemini CLI Usage Statistics to Google by following the instructions available here: [Usage Statistics Configuration].
